facts.fact: Report the threat immediately on cybercrime.gov.in or call the cybercrime helpline 1930
facts.quote: If you are a victim of cybercrime, report immediately at https://www.cybercrime.gov.in/ or call 1930.

facts.fact: Such threats and online harassment are reported under 'Report Other Cybercrimes' on the portal (covers online and social media crimes)
facts.quote: Report Other Cybercrimes – Under this option, you can report complaints pertaining to cybercrimes such as mobile crimes, online and social media crimes, online financial frauds, ransomware, hacking, cryptocurrency crimes, and online cyber trafficking.

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish; tells the user to report the loan-app threats on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) or call 1930, citing it.
fail_if: Does not mention cybercrime.gov.in or 1930, advises paying the loan app to stop the threats, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: cybercrime.gov.in: report immediately on the portal or call 1930; threats/harassment go under 'Report Other Cybercrimes'.
